package.name: genie_sim_dual_arm_manip
package.description: High-level task orchestration for dual-arm pick-and-place on Genie G2. Drives a configurable MoveIt planning group (see genie_sim_moveit) through a small named-pose state machine (default, pick_ready, pick, pick_hold, place_hold, place_ready, place) and the parallel-jaw grippers over /joint_command. Target poses for the pick/place states can be overridden at runtime by an external perception node — this package does not implement perception itself.
